column1: # Every Pokémon Center and Poké Mart on John's map: the button over each one's doorway (its sign), found by a scan of
# the map (a mangrove button over a Center's, a pale oak one over a Mart's, each checked against Viridian's). The doorway is
# 3 wide, 5 below and 3 in from the button. All of them go into the one Center and the one Mart (tools/interior/export/tomod.py).
